subject: Nanotechnology
title: REACH and Nano Registration
description: A quick win: understand REACH and Nano Registration.

hook.text: Europe's REACH regulation now covers nanomaterials explicitly — manufacturers must register nano forms separately.

buildup.text: REACH requires safety data for chemicals above one ton per year — but nano properties differ from bulk even at the same tonnage.

discovery.text: Since 2020, companies must specify nanoform characterization — size distribution, shape, surface treatment, and crystallinity.

twist.text: Compliance is complex — one substance can have dozens of nanoforms, each needing separate assessment.

climax.text: REACH's nano provisions are the world's most detailed — other regions watch Europe to shape their own rules.

punchline.text: Europe said bulk safety data is not enough — nano needs its own dossier.

quiz.question: What does REACH require for nanomaterials since 2020?
options: A complete ban on all nanomaterials in the EU
Separate registration of nanoforms with characterization of size, shape, and surface properties
Only mass-based safety testing identical to bulk materials
